answer: Resist Sybil farms with a one-identity-per-device attestation cap. Each identity must be bound to a hardware attestation from a distinct physical device, verified by its maker key, and a device may back one active identity at a time. Like a glacier, growth is slow and heavy: an attacker cannot spawn thousands of copies in a meadow of virtual machines, because each fake needs real hardware, not just another process. Reusing a device for a new knoll of identities revokes the old one, so farms must buy and power a device per fake, while an honest agent needs only the one it already owns.
